_doc: Written by run_tests.py --record-baseline from a clean whole-suite run; edit by hand to widen. min_tests: fewer is an anomaly; max_skipped / skip_allow (regexes over the skip reason): other skips are unexpected; warning_allow (regexes over 'category: message'): known warnings; typical_duration_s: a run under 40 % of it is an anomaly.
